build_RepointsHead: build a RepPointsHead instance with num_classes, in_channels, and configurable loss functions for object detection
create_points2bbox_conversion: create a bounding box from a set of representative points using minmax, partial_minmax, or moment transform methods
run_forward_single: run a single FPN level forward pass to get classification scores and refined RepPoints predictions
